commands.command:
python3 -I -c '
import csv, re
y = open("configs/demo/mappings-sandbox.example.yaml").read()
src = re.findall(r"name: *src_(env|soc)_([a-z0-9_]+)", y)
for sec, k in src:
    for yr in ("2025", "2024"):
        assert re.search(r"name: *rpt_%s_%s_%s\b" % (sec, k, yr), y), (sec, k, yr)
rows = {}
for yr in ("2025", "2024"):
    p = "configs/demo/data/esg-%s.csv" % yr
    assert open(p).readline().strip() == "key,label,unit,value", p
    rows[yr] = [(r["key"], r["label"], r["unit"]) for r in csv.DictReader(open(p))]
assert rows["2025"] == rows["2024"]
assert [k for _, k in src] == [r[0] for r in rows["2025"]]
assert len(set(k for _, k in src)) == len(src)
env = [k for s, k in src if s == "env"]
assert [k for _, k in src][:len(env)] == env, "environmental fields first"
'

grep -qx '## Live write semantics' configs/demo/README.md && grep -qxE 'clear-value: (null|empty-string)' configs/demo/README.md && grep -qxE 'percent-cells-store-fractions: (yes|no)' configs/demo/README.md
